notes: MAIN TEXTBOOK: Let's Discover More English, 8th Year, Student's Book. Its Activity Book companion is 141807. 5 modules with 5 lessons each. The book has no TOC; it has a Module Map per module, and the module-1 map (p6) gives lesson titles. Other lessons come from the headings. The modules carry no printed titles, so the top level uses 5 positional labels 'Module N'. Lesson 1 of each module is a 'Review and introductory lesson', named by its topic. Module 2 lesson 1 shows only 'Review and introductory lesson' in this extract. Its title 'English secondary schools (1)' is taken from the companion Activity Book 141807. The Lighter side / Jokes pages, the Episode serial pages, Grammar Focus, List of words and Irregular verbs were excluded.
